modified_workflow: 01 build_and_pdfinfo: unchanged; the builder iterates groups.json groups (7 source pages per group -> 6 live pages), removing the 'Draft: ' prefix, dropping the obsolete divider, reordering live pages and adding bookmarks/page labels over the whole binder
02 final_text: unchanged pdftotext -layout over the output PDF
03 page_labels_and_bookmarks: unchanged pypdf page-label and outline dump, now spanning all scaled groups

04 render_contact_sheet: unchanged pdftoppm -png -r 130 + one montage 3x2 -label %f invocation over every retained live page; because the montage tile grid is 3x2 and the retained page count (30/120) exceeds 6, ImageMagick writes one numbered contact-sheet tile (output-contact-0.png, ...) per 3x2 grid page instead of a single output-contact.png. The command lists all produced tiles; this is the same single tool invocation as the parent, scaled by page count
05 forbidden_text_diagnostic: unchanged pdftotext | rg over the output PDF

scale_metadata.parameterized: The fixed 7-page source block and 6-page live scope are parameterized over all groups: source page indexes, obsolete page indexes, absolute bookmark targets and page-label prefixes are computed over the whole scaled binder.
scale_metadata.preserved_parent_behavior: 130 DPI pdftoppm page rendering with montage 3x2, geometry +18+24 and -label %f contact sheet; page labels equal the visible section titles; input metadata preserved with /Title overridden to 'Closeout Binder'; no AcroForm handling is introduced (the rebuild neither reads nor writes AcroForm structures).
scale_metadata.changed_parent_behavior: The builder iterates every groups.json group through the real read-strip-drop-reorder-labelling path instead of a single fixed 7-page seed; live pages are never duplicated.

measurement_scope: Scales the number of frozen binder groups that actually flow through the real read/prefix-strip/obsolete-drop/reorder/bookmark/label rebuild. 5 groups -> 35 input / 30 output pages, 20 groups -> 140 input / 120 output pages. Every retained live page is rendered at 130 DPI into the 3x2 contact sheet; pages are never duplicated.
